scope: Private bounded P4/D1 raw activity acquisition; no fitting or public disclosure
metadata_selection: Up to100 assay metadata rows per query in API-default order, then numerical ChEMBL-ID order; keep target/species/confidence filters as explicit sampling criteria, not proof of assay purity. Select first declared number, remove assay-ID overlap from later groups, record every metadata response and all chosen IDs before activity acquisition.
structure_policy: Retain canonical_smiles and molecule/parent/record IDs exactly as ChEMBL supplied; this is source-reported standardized structure, not a claim to recover the original physical assayed form. No local neutralization, fragment removal, stereo removal or tautomer merging.
label_policy: Keep original and standard type/value/units/relation and all flags. No AC50/Ki pooling intoIC50. No bounds from single-concentration,Emax,missingness orTDI labels. Censored records retained separately for a later factor.
bindingdb: Metadata-only accessibility/schema/license/overlap check. No getLigandsByUniprots target-wide download or affinity-cutoff-defined negative pool.
next_step: Freeze raw occurrences, unique activity/compound/assay inventory, provenance and overlap. Propose identical-record/compound-weight pooled versus context-aware comparison; no fit is authorized here.
